readout_other: sucrose preference test; forced swimming test; open field test; elevated-plus maze; in vivo LFP/synaptic plasticity recording (I/O, PPF, PTP/STP/LTP) from vCA1-mPFC; Golgi-cox staining of dendritic spines; western blot of NR2B, PSD95, SYP
direction_notes: LIFUS restored synaptic functional plasticity (PTP, STP, LTP) and theta-band phase synchronization in the vCA1-mPFC pathway that had been suppressed by chronic unpredictable stress, and increased dendritic spine density and NR2B/PSD95 expression in mPFC, alongside improved (antidepressant-like) behaviour.
safety_notes: HE staining of the mPFC after 2 weeks of isoflurane anesthesia and LIFUS revealed intact brain structure and neurons.

exposures.label: LIFUS to left medial prefrontal cortex, high (500 mW/cm2) and low (230 mW/cm2) intensity

timing.protocol_description: LIFUS (0.5 MHz, 2 kHz PRF, 60% duty cycle, 0.3 ms tone-burst duration, 0.5 s sonication duration) delivered with a 2 s inter-stimulus interval, applied for 15 min daily for two consecutive weeks after chronic unpredictable stress (CUS) modelling, in two separate batches using 500 mW/cm2 (n=8 exposed) or 230 mW/cm2 (n=9 exposed) intensity; control/CUS-only groups received sham LIFUS.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The LIFUS system is shown in Fig. 1(A). The LIFUS parameters used for chronic stimulation in this study were as follows (Fig. 1C): 0.5 MHz center frequency, 2 kHz pulse repetition frequency (PRF), 60% duty cycle, 0.3 ms tone-burst duration, 0.5 s sonication duration (SD), and 2s inter-stimulus interval. The acoustic intensity field was measured in a degassed water tank by a calibrated hydrophone (NH4000, Precision acoustics, Dorchester, UK). For X–Y and X–Z planes scanning with 1-mm steps, the hydrophone was placed at the focal zone of ultrasound transducer. The acoustic distribution on X–Y and X–Z planes were showed in the Fig. 1(B). The acoustic distribution on X–Y indicated that the full-width at half-maximum focal zone was 4 4 mm<sup>2</sup>. The spatial peak temporal average intensity $\left( \mathrm { I } _ { \mathrm { s p t a } } \right)$ was 500 and 230 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> respectively. The stimulation region was confined to the left prefrontal cortex (3.5 mm anterior and 0.75 mm lateral to the bregma) by the a custom-designed acoustic collimator. The LIFUS treatment was applied for 15 min daily for two consecutive weeks. During the LIFUS, all rats were mounted on the stereotaxic apparatus (RWD, Shenzhen, China) and anesthetized with 1% isof lurane (RWD, Shenzhen, China). Before applying the LIFUS, the hair on the bilateral mPFC was shaved. To rule out the effects of 2 weeks of isoflurane anesthesia, the other rats in either CON or CUS groups underwent the same procedures including anesthesia but without LIFUS. We examed the mPFC using HE staining to look for evidence of tissue damage and the result revealed intact brain structure and neurons (Supplementary Fig. S1).

source_quotes.n_subjects: In order to evaluate the therapeutic effect of the LIFUS with two intensities, the experiment was carried out in two batches. An ideal experiment should be performed in the same batch. However, the process of the LIFUS is very time-consuming and each rat needs about 30 min to complete. Besides, we only have one LIFUS system. With limited conditions, in order to ensure sufficient sample size in all groups, we performed the experiment in two batches. In the first batch, 27 male SD rats were used to examine the effect of 500 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> LIFUS. They were randomly divided into the CON (n 10) and the model group (n 17). Rats of the CON group were housed with standard housing, while the model group received the CUS procedure for 9 weeks. After CUS modeling, rats of the model group were randomly divided into two subgroups: the CUS group (CUS rats without LIFUS treatment, n  9) and CUS 500 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> LIFUS group (CUS rats with 500 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> LIFUS treatment, n  8). The CUS  500 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> LIFUS group was treated by 500 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> LIFUS daily for 2 weeks, whereas the other groups were treated with sham LIFUS. At the end of LIFUS treatment, behavioral tests were performed to evaluate depressionlike behaviors. After behavioral tests, the electrophysiological recording in vivo and western blotting analysis were performed to explore the underlying mechanisms. The experimental schedule was shown in Fig. 1(D).
